newsitem.title: USA: LPC - Willis Stein taps banks for $260 mln bank loan.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Willis Stein taps banks for $260 mln bank loan.

text.p: NEW YORK, Oct 18 (LPC) - First Union Corp and Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce are leading a $260 million bank loan for Willis Stein & Partners, banking sources said.
The bank loan will be used for the buyout of Petersen Publishing, banking sources added.
The banks also are providing $100 million in bridge financing, until $100 million of subordinated notes are issued in November, sources added.
The loan is split between a $60 million revolving tranche and a $100 million term loan, both 6.25 years in maturity, a banker said.
In addition, there is also a $100 million, eight-year "B" term loan to be sold to prime rate funds and insurance companies, the banker added.
Willis Stein plans to acquire additional publications to add on to the publishing company, sources said.
